name: Card Authorization Service
description: Authorizes debit and credit card transactions from POS, e-commerce and ATM channels.

name: HSM Gateway
description: Brokers PIN verification and cryptogram validation requests to the hardware security modules.

name: National Payment Switch Connector
description: Sends and receives interbank instant transfers through the national payment switch.

name: End-of-Day Settlement Batch
description: Nightly batch that posts card and transfer settlements to the general ledger.

name: Fraud Scoring Client
description: Calls the external VeriScore fraud API and applies the Bank's rule overlays.

name: Core Banking Adapter
description: Translates channel requests into core banking ledger operations.

name: Ledger Database Cluster
description: PostgreSQL primary with two synchronous replicas holding account balances and postings.

name: Mobile Banking API
description: Backend for the retail mobile banking app.

name: Identity Service
description: Issues and validates customer session tokens and step-up authentication.

name: QR Payments Service
description: Merchant-presented QR payments for retail customers.

name: Merchant Settlement Portal
description: Web portal where merchants view settlements and download statements.

name: Notification Service
description: Sends SMS and push notifications, including one-time passwords.
